treaty_name: Agreement between the Republic of Armenia and Ireland for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital gains (2011, as modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: [IE list] Double Taxation Treaty between Ireland and the Republic of Armenia — Agreement between the Government of Ireland and the Government of the Republic of Armenia for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital || [AM MLI position] ...Income and on Capital Ireland Original 14-07-2011 19-12-2012
source_title: MLI matching and synthesised text Armenia-Ireland (Armenian MoF)

rates.quote: a) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership)— (i) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends; and (ii) which has owned that holding for a period of at least 2 years prior to any claim being made under this subparagraph; and (iii) which, in the Contracting State of which it is a resident, is, in respect of the dividends, entirely relieved from tax by an exemption or would, but for this subparagraph, be entirely relieved by a credit

b) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
c) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
c) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest in all other cases.
if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of Agreement, a benefit under the Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit

notes: Dividend 0% tier: holding >=25% owned for at least 2 years prior to the claim (modelled as 730 days) and dividends fully relieved in residence State by exemption or credit. Interest: 0% if paid to a Contracting State/local authority/Central Bank/wholly-owned State institution (Art. 11(2)(a)); 5% on loans granted by a banking enterprise (Art. 11(2)(b)) - government and bank tiers not modelled. Art. 29: in Armenia WHT on income derived on or after 1 January of the year following EIF; in Ireland income tax for years of assessment / corporation tax for financial years beginning on or after 1 January following EIF (EIF 2012-12-18/19 -> 2013-01-01 either way). Synthesised text: MLI effective for WHT from 1 January 2024. MLI Art. 8 not applied.
